daily_activity_plans.ddl:
CREATE TABLE daily_activity_plans (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	local_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	timezone_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	timezone_contract_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	repertoire_id VARCHAR(64), 
	generation_source VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'repertoire' NOT NULL, 
	preparation_contract_version VARCHAR(40) DEFAULT 'repertoire-v1' NOT NULL, 
	world_definition_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	character_definition_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	repertoire_contract_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	selection_contract_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	selection_seed_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	revision_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plans_version CHECK (version >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repertoire_id) REFERENCES world_activity_repertoires (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_daily_activity_plans_character_date UNIQUE (world_character_id, local_date), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plans_status CHECK (status IN ('planned','active','completed','interrupted','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plans_source CHECK (generation_source IN ('repertoire','daily_generation') AND (generation_source != 'repertoire' OR repertoire_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_daily_activity_plans_world_character_scope FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id, world_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id, world_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_daily_activity_plans_scope UNIQUE (id, world_id, world_character_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plans_revision_count CHECK (revision_count >= 0 AND revision_count <= 2)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_daily_activity_plans_world_date ON daily_activity_plans (world_id, local_date)

daily_activity_plan_items.ddl:
CREATE TABLE daily_activity_plan_items (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	daypart VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	selected_candidate_id VARCHAR(64), 
	candidate_signature VARCHAR(64), 
	candidate_ordinal INTEGER, 
	origin_type VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'repertoire' NOT NULL, 
	supersedes_plan_item_id VARCHAR(64), 
	is_user_pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	activity_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	activity_seed VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	social_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	place_key VARCHAR(64), 
	joint_activity_id VARCHAR(64), 
	scheduled_start_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	scheduled_end_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	revision_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	terminal_reason_code VARCHAR(80), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plan_items_revision_count CHECK (revision_count >= 0 AND revision_count <= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plan_items_origin CHECK (origin_type IN ('repertoire','joint_activity','daily_generation')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(selected_candidate_id) REFERENCES world_activity_candidates (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_daily_activity_plan_items_scope UNIQUE (id, world_id, world_character_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plan_items_window CHECK (scheduled_start_at < scheduled_end_at), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_daily_activity_plan_items_plan_scope FOREIGN KEY(plan_id, world_id, world_character_id) REFERENCES daily_activity_plans (id, world_id, world_character_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plan_items_daypart CHECK (daypart IN ('dawn','morning','afternoon','evening')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plan_items_version CHECK (version >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_plan_item_id) REFERENCES daily_activity_plan_items (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_daily_activity_plan_items_joint_scope FOREIGN KEY(joint_activity_id, world_id) REFERENCES joint_activities (id, world_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_daily_activity_plan_items_status CHECK (status IN ('planned','active','completed','skipped','interrupted','cancelled','superseded'))
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_daily_activity_plan_items_character_window ON daily_activity_plan_items (world_character_id, scheduled_start_at, scheduled_end_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_daily_activity_plan_items_current_daypart ON daily_activity_plan_items (plan_id, daypart) WHERE status != 'superseded'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_daily_activity_plan_items_joint_participant ON daily_activity_plan_items (joint_activity_id, world_character_id) WHERE joint_activity_id IS NOT NULL AND status != 'superseded'

activity_preparation_jobs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE activity_preparation_jobs (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	local_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	timezone_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	contract_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	claim_token VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	next_retry_at DATETIME, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	json_retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	input_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason_code VARCHAR(100), 
	plan_id VARCHAR(64), 
	plan_version INTEGER, 
	input_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	applied_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	usage_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_activity_preparation_scope FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id, world_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id, world_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_activity_preparation_attempts CHECK (attempt_count >= 0 AND attempt_count <= 4), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_activity_preparation_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','running','waiting','ready','failed','needs_user_action','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_activity_preparation_request UNIQUE (world_character_id, local_date, request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_activity_preparation_mode CHECK (mode IN ('initial','daily','manual_plan'))
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_activity_preparation_due ON activity_preparation_jobs (state, next_retry_at)
